VI.description: Encodes raw LabVIEW image data as a PNG file in memory\2C through LVImageDataToPNGByteArray\2C the function LabVIEW itself exports (library LabVIEW\2C C calling convention\2C called in any thread) and NI's LV Image to PNG Data.vi calls. Unlike that VI it takes the zlib level in every LabVIEW version\3A LabVIEW 2020's copy of it has no compression input and always writes an uncompressed PNG. compression is the zlib level\3A 0 none\2C 1 fastest\2C 9 smallest\2C -1 zlib's default\3B above 9 the function returns an empty png and no error. When error in carries an error the function is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.
